subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + interim bridge letter for Astra Health procurement
messages:
From: Emily Rogers <emily.rogers@astrahealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@astrahealth.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + interim bridge letter for procurement

Hi Neha,

Astra Health is in the final stages of vendor review for a pilot and our procurement team has asked for the following items so we can clear the security gate:

- SOC 2 Type II report covering period ending 31 May 2026
- Interim / bridge letter confirming controls are in effect since 31 May 2026 up to our required attestation date (we're looking for coverage through 31 Oct 2026 or confirmation of controls status to the current date)
- Any auditor contact if KPMG needs to validate directly

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a bridge letter that explains there have been no material control changes since the report period end, and share a checklist of evidence you can provide (controls owner names, recent change logs, SOC remediation items if any)? Our procurement deadline for a signed attestation is Oct 14, 2026.

If helpful we can schedule a 20-minute call. Thanks — appreciate a quick confirm so I can update the procurement queue.

Best,
Emily Rogers
Senior Procurement Manager
Astra Health

Quick answers up front:
- We issued our latest SOC 2 Type II covering period ending 31 May 2026 (report attached).
- We typically provide a bridge letter that: (1) confirms the report period end, (2) lists any material changes to the control environment since that date, and (3) states whether any other attestation or remediation items are outstanding.

I'll loop in our compliance team (Laura and Rishi) to pull the checklist and a working draft. Marissa from Audit Ops will help with the auditor contact details if KPMG needs to be reached.

We should be able to get a draft to you by EOD 10/07; final sign-off may require legal review — if the Oct 14 procurement cutoff is firm we can escalate for an expedited signature.

Neha / team — attaching a compliance checklist and a first-pass bridge letter draft (v0.3). Summary of what's required from us and what I'll need from Product/Infra if procurement wants explicit evidence:

Required for a standard bridge letter:
- Statement of report period end date (done)
- Statement that there have been no material changes to controls since period end OR description of any material changes (we need confirmation from infra leads if any config/control changes were released flagged as material)
- Attestation on outstanding remediation items (yes/no + short list if any)
- Auditor contact for confirmation (Marissa will provide)

Evidence checklist we can supply quickly:
- Change log extracts (control-related changes) — last 6 months
- Incident summaries (if any) and remediation tickets
- Control owner names and contact info
- Latest penetration test summary (redacted)
- KMS/HSM configuration snapshot and key rotation record (redacted)

Notes/asks:
- Rishi: confirm whether there were any control-relevant infra changes between 2026-06-01 and 2026-10-05. If there were, we need a short description to include in the bridge letter.
- Marissa: please share the KPMG SOC contact (email/phone) in case Astra wants direct auditor validation.

Target timeline: draft v0.3 attached today; goal is to get Emily a v0.4 by EOD 10/07 after Rishi confirmation. Legal review will be required for the final wording.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Compliance & Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
